mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customers (name, email, phone, valid) VALUES (#{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT customer_id AS customerId, name, email, phone, valid FROM customers WHERE name = #{name}
SELECT customer_id AS customerId, name, email, phone, valid FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT customer_id AS customerId, name, email, phone, valid FROM customers WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE customers SET valid = 0 WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
UPDATE customers SET valid = 1 WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
